completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.label.source: Import an owned completed private result
completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.label.text: 导入自己拥有的已完成私密结果

completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.guidanc.source: Import retained excerpts from the selected completed private result. This action reads your saved result and starts no new research or purchase.
completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.guidanc.text: 从所选的已完成私密结果导入留存摘录。此操作读取已保存结果，不启动新研究或购买。

completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.privacy.source: The result stays in this tab. Exact saved-ledger provenance is separate from semantic support and creator payment authority. An editable or downloaded report cannot authenticate itself when reimported.
completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.privacy.text: 结果保留在此标签页中。确切的已保存账本来源记录与语义支持、创作者付款权限分别处理。可编辑或已下载的报告重新导入时不能自行证明真实性。

ready.source: Saved metadata checked. Import is now available for this exact saved result and current Include papers.
ready.text: 已检查已保存元数据。现在可导入这一确切的已保存结果，并使用当前标记为 Include 的论文。

signIn.source: Sign in to read an owned completed result. Your draft edits are preserved.
signIn.text: 登录以读取自己拥有的已完成结果。草稿编辑将保留。

changed.source: The owner, selection, or Include papers changed. Read saved metadata again. Your draft edits are preserved.
changed.text: 所有者、选择或标记为 Include 的论文发生变化。请重新读取已保存元数据。草稿编辑将保留。

invalid.source: Enter a complete existing private job ID and mark at least one paper Include.
invalid.text: 输入完整的现有私密任务 ID，并至少将一篇论文标记为 Include。

completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.unavail.source: Completed private result unavailable or changed. Your draft is preserved.
completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.unavail.text: 已完成私密结果不可用或发生变化。草稿将保留。

storage.source: The current backend cannot provide this retained completed result. Your draft edits are preserved; retry is an explicit action.
storage.text: 当前后端无法提供此留存的已完成结果。草稿编辑将保留；重试需要明确操作。

completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.timedOu.source: Private read timed out. Your draft is preserved; retry is an explicit action.
completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.timedOu.text: 私密读取超时。草稿将保留；重试需要明确操作。

completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.importe.source: Retained report appended. Existing draft edits are preserved. Semantic support is unjudged; downloaded or edited reports have caller-supplied origin.
completedEvidenceDraftImportCopy.importe.text: 留存报告已追加。现有草稿编辑将保留。语义支持尚未评判；下载或编辑的报告采用调用者提供的来源信息。

empty.source: This completed result has no usable exact retained excerpts. Reading observations imported; unavailable and unknown remain separate. Existing draft edits are preserved.
empty.text: 此已完成结果没有可用的确切留存摘录。已导入阅读观察记录；不可用与未知仍分别处理。现有草稿编辑将保留。

completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.labe.text: 选择自己拥有的已完成结果

completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.guid.source: Enter an existing private job ID. Read its saved metadata, then explicitly import its retained excerpts. No new research or purchase is started.
completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.guid.text: 输入现有私密任务 ID。读取其已保存的元数据，然后明确导入其留存摘录。不启动新研究或购买。

completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.priv.source: Saved metadata and imported excerpts stay in this tab. They are not saved to the literature workspace or uploaded elsewhere.
completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.priv.text: 已保存的元数据和导入的摘录保留在此标签页中。它们不会保存到文献工作区，也不会上传到其他地方。

completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.read.text: 正在读取已保存元数据…

completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.unav.source: This completed result or its exact saved URL and version identities are unavailable. Your draft edits are preserved.
completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.unav.text: 此已完成结果或其确切的已保存 URL 和版本标识不可用。草稿编辑将保留。

completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.time.source: The saved metadata read timed out. Your draft edits are preserved; retry is an explicit action.
completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.time.text: 读取已保存元数据超时。草稿编辑将保留；重试需要明确操作。

completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.impo.source: Completed report and reading observations imported; draft edits are preserved.
completedEvidenceDraftSelectionCopy.impo.text: 已导入已完成报告和阅读观察记录；草稿编辑将保留。
